qr_sample — SYMBOL datacode2d op

• Data kinds: image2d → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.qr_sample(image, located=None) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import qrsym; qrsym.qr_sample(image, located=None) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opssymbol.get("qr_sample"))

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Sample the reflectance at QR module centres by bilinear interpolation and binarise with a global threshold (table).

Sample module-centre reflectance (bilinear) and binarise with one global threshold midway between the dark- and light-module means (refined iteratively). Returns reflectance (N,N), modules (N,N) uint8 (dark=1), threshold, homography and centers (N,N,2) pixel (row, col).
